actions.description: Exercise the HTTP contract and restart persistence
actions.command:
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import http.client

def request(method, path, body=None):
    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', 8080, timeout=5)
    headers = {} if body is None else {'Content-Length': str(len(body))}
    conn.request(method, path, body=body, headers=headers)
    response = conn.getresponse()
    result = response.status, response.read()
    conn.close()
    return result

assert request('GET', '/health') == (200, b'ready')
payload = b'first\x00payload\xff\n'
assert request('PUT', '/records/durable-check', payload) == (204, b'')
assert request('GET', '/records/durable-check') == (200, payload)
